Class Multisets

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.collect.Multisets
public final class Multisets extends Object
Static factories and a collector for unmodifiable multisets that iterate in the order their elements first appear, with all occurrences of an element in a row: multiset("foo", "bar", "foo") iterates over foo, foo, bar.

They behave like the sets of Sets:

  • They are unmodifiable: every mutator method throws UnsupportedOperationException, even when the call would not change the multiset. That includes the methods of their views, their iterators and their entries.
  • They reject null elements, and querying them with null, as in count(null), throws NullPointerException.
  • They are serializable if all their elements are.
  • They are value-based: do not rely on their identity.
  • equals and hashCode follow the Multiset contract, so a multiset from this class equals any multiset with the same elements and counts, whatever their order.
Since:
0.1.1
